{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload data to start fresh
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to all customers who converted (converted == 1), as per contract
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Check for QA orders in this group
qa_in_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA orders among converted: {len(qa_in_converted)}')

# Check for refunded orders among converted
refunded_in_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Refunded orders among converted: {len(refunded_in_converted)}')

# Now, compute mean age of all converted customers (including refunded and QA orders)
# But note: QA orders have revenue 999999.99 — are they real? Data dictionary says they are internal QA — not real
# However, the contract says: 'all customers who converted' — so we must include them unless we have a reason to exclude
# But if they are not real, including them biases the mean

# The data dictionary says: 'Six internal QA orders were left in the export', and they are not real
# Therefore, they should be excluded from any real analysis, even if they have converted == 1

# So, exclude QA orders (revenue_numeric == 999999.99) from the converted group
# But keep refunded orders, because the contract says to include all converted customers

# So, filtered converted customers: exclude QA orders, keep refunded
filtered_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Now, compute mean age, but exclude -1 values (sentinel)
# The contract does not say to exclude -1, but they are not valid ages
# The data dictionary says: '-1 means the customer did not supply an age'
# So, we must exclude them from the mean calculation

# Compute mean age only on valid age data (not -1)
valid_age_converted = filtered_converted[filtered_converted['customer_age'] != -1]

mean_age_converted = valid_age_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Print required numbers
print(f'Total converted customers (with converted == 1): {len(converted_customers)}')
print(f'QA orders among converted: {len(qa_in_converted)}')
print(f'Refunded orders among converted: {len(refunded_in_converted)}')
print(f'Valid converted customers with non-missing age: {len(valid_age_converted)}')
print(f'Mean age of converted customers (valid age, excluding QA): {mean_age_converted}')"}
